notes.title: VilleTown: Brave New World Released!
notes.notes:
The Brave New World Update is here! It brings a huge overhaul to VilleTown that aims to improve the overall atmosphere and engagement of the game!

Patchnotes:
====Major Changes====
Added Quests- tasks that give players rewards for completing them, and provide a guide for how to progress after the tutorial ends.

Added a Difficulty Slider- Allows players to experience VilleTown at the level they desire. They can nerf everything into the ground or make the game a Hell on Earth.

Added New Defensive Buildings- Now there will be a new level of strategy in defending your VilleTown! With tons of defensive buildings to be unlocked, you will be able to create impenetrable fortresses or giant death traps to your heart’s content.

Added New Unique Units- There are many different types of unique units in the game, allowing players to assign their population to do unique, specialized tasks.

Added New Map Generation- There are new biomes to explore and many new things to discover in the ever growing world of VilleTown!

Added Scoring System- Keep trying to beat your old high score with new strategies and on harder difficulties!

----Minor Changes----
-Mineshafts have new layers!
-There is a new Resource!
-Dynamic Sky color changes
-Artifact level cap increased to 8
-Terrain Insight
-Misc bug fixes/ feature tweaks

Enjoy,
-The Laugical Games Staff

notes.title: VilleTown: Brave New World Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
The Brave New World Update is going to be a huge overhaul to VilleTown that aims to improve the cohesiveness and engagement of the game. With 5 huge major changes and dozens of minor changes, this update with drastically improve the way people play VT. The 5 major changes include:

Quests-
To help give players direction in what to be aiming for after the tutorial ends.

A Difficulty Slider-
Allows players to experience VilleTown at the level they desire. They can nerf everything into the ground or make the game a Hell on Earth.

New Defensive Buildings-
Now there will be a strategy to how you defend your VilleTown. With tons of defensive buildings that have lots of different effects, you will be able to create impenetrable fortresses or giant death traps to your heart’s content.

New Unique Units-
To perform the jobs that aren’t covered by the 6 main ones. From Engineers that can be manually assigned to repair things, to Cavalry that swiftly attack hordes of enemies, they will add much more flavor to the game.

Exploration-
Players’ views will be restricted early on to a much smaller area that can only be lengthened by expanding your VilleTown or scouting out the map. However, unlike before, there will be many mysteries and secrets to uncover, as there are now different biomes and terrain types that affect your VilleTown in many different ways.

The minor changes will include things from having multiple layers of Mineshafts, to an entirely new and mysterious resource, to SAVING SOUND DATA! :D

We hope you are looking forward to this update as much as we are! If you have any suggestions for any of the sections, feel free to add them to the discussions!

Looking forward to your feedback,
-The Laugical Games Staff

notes.title: Some Bugs and Hotfixes
notes.notes:
Some minor bugs and hotfixes were patched in these past few versions, and I wanted to let you guys know what they were incase you were experiencing them and were annoyed.
-Clicking "Retry" after getting the defeat screen sometimes not stopping the defeat music [fixed]
-Assigning builders during the tutorial before told to do so could get you stuck [fixed]
-Forestries not being destroyable [fixed]
-Trying to upgrade Forestries crashed the game [fixed] (You don't upgrade Forestries by the way! They upgrade with Artifacts)

WARNING: This update unfortunately corrupts your save files. However, the update is optional- the way to install it is by uninstalling and reinstalling VilleTown. Of course, you can play your saves as normal with these bugs in mind and just work around them. Sorry for the inconvenience!

Thanks and happy building,
-Laugic
